t2i_prompt: A 1440 px wide desktop web section as a flat straight-on UI mockup in editorial magazine style. A deep navy field holds an oversized light-weight white sans headline on two lines, cropped by the left edge. A warm limestone sheet steps in from the right and below, with a notch where the headline crosses. On the sheet, a navy hairline block diagram of <CONTENT> with solid and dashed signal lines, and five callouts with steel-blue mono numerals, a bold short label and a line of body, joined by hairline leaders. Tiny mono eyebrow. Flat, square corners, no shading.
signature_idea: A giant cropped headline on navy sits over a limestone sheet that carries the control architecture as a hairline diagram with numbered callouts.
strengths: strong editorial impact from the cropped light headline
diagram shows a real layered architecture with clear numbered callouts
palette is navy, limestone and one steel-blue accent with square corners
buildable: two colour fields, display type and an SVG diagram
weaknesses: callout 02 (PLC) is duplicated, once top right and once bottom left
leader lines do not reliably meet the boxes they name; bottom-left leader runs to nothing
diagram wiring on the left is dense, meaningless bus lines
bold callout titles break the light-type rule
headline crop is very tight on 'H', may read as a cut rather than a choice
brand_fit_why: Light oversized type, navy/limestone fields, steel-blue mono numerals and hairline art fit, but duplicated callouts, bold labels and noisy wiring reduce precision.
